debrief db-021

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d t-h-e l-o-c-k i-n-t-e-r-l-o-c-k m-e-c-h-a-n-i-s-m-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n, c-r-e-a-t-e-d a-n i-l-l-e-g-a-l e-x-c-l-u-s-i-o-n, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e c-o-u-r-t o-r-d-e-r p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d t-h-r-e-a-t-e-n-i-n-g c-o-r-r-e-s-p-o-n-d-e-n-c-e t-o t-h-e r-e-n-t, l-e-f-t w-r-i-t-t-e-n i-n-t-i-m-i-d-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d f-o-r-m-a-l l-e-g-a l p-r-o-c-e-e-d-i-n-g s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e t-o m-a-k-e t-h-e p-r-e-m-i-s-e-s u-n-i-n-h-a-b-i-t-a-b-l-e, c-r-e-a-t-e-d h-a-z-a-r-d-o-u-s c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d h-a-b-i-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-b-s-t-r-u-c-t-e-d a-u-d-i-t o-r-g-a-n-i-z-a-t-i-o-n a-c-c-e-s-s t-o t-h-e p-r-o-p-e-r-t-y, l-e-f-t s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y l-o-g g-a-p-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k-s.
